start: ^It is dangerous to speak here. The council chamber was closed to many of us tonight, but the decision was made before the candles were lit.
^I have the means to secure the remains from the governor's staff, but it requires using up all my political leverage.
^Conscience is an expensive thing to buy back when you have kept silent for too long.

s: ^Will the rest of the Sanhedrin oppose your request to Pilate?
